purpose: Source-authoring briefs only; never mark a unit as rendered, shipped, painted, or Xbox-accepted based on a brief

shared.layout: 4 columns x 4 rows; frames 0-7 walking, 8-15 attack (wind-up, contact, recovery); one intact character or vehicle per cell
shared.style: Original painted pre-rendered medieval RTS unit art, slightly elevated isometric three-quarter view matching existing Crown & Kingdoms sprite sheets, upper-left lighting, detailed metal/leather/cloth, realistic readable silhouette at gameplay scale; neutral transparent background, consistent feet or hull waterline anchors, original blue heraldry accents for 4-team recolouring
shared.forbid: No labels, grid lines, border, backdrop, vignette, colored halo, stray effects, copied game art, duplicated bodies or cropped weapons, feet, wings, wheels, rigging or sails
review: Open original 4x4 PNG and compare with corresponding existing painted atlas at play scale
Check all 16 figures, independent movements, coherent equipment and anatomy, aligned bottom anchors and complete equipment
Use scripts/check-motion-source.mjs on native 1536x1024 PNG before converting; do not bypass failures by upscaling a malformed poster
Import via scripts/build-motion-atlas.mjs --source KIND /path/to/approved.png; rebuild manifests, offline art revision hashes and cache version as appropriate
Validate four team tints, all eight walk/attack frames, cold/warm/offline fallback, actual Chromium render and game simulation invariance; physical Xbox acceptance separately
